sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `qwen-code`
- Canonical name: Qwen Code (`claim-qwen-code-sf-identity`)
- Vendor: Qwen (`claim-qwen-code-sf-vendor`). Official overview also names Alibaba ModelStudio / Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan as the first-party model path (`claim-qwen-code-sf-vendor-alibaba`). LICENSE copyrights Google LLC and Qwen (`claim-qwen-code-sf-copyright`)
- Canonical URL: https://qwenlm.github.io/qwen-code-docs/en/users/overview/ (`claim-qwen-code-sf-canonical-url`)
- Repository: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code (`claim-qwen-code-sf-repository-url`)
- Current status: active public repository (`claim-qwen-code-sf-status`)
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-15
- CLI latest labeled v0.21.12 on GitHub (`claim-qwen-code-sf-version`). Main-branch `package.json` still listed 0.21.11 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-version-main-package`). Desktop latest tag is an auto-update feed for desktop-v0.0.5 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-version-desktop`)
- License: Apache-2.0 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-license`)

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: an open-source terminal coding agent that also ships IDE hosts, a desktop app, a daemon, SDKs, and IM/code-host channels (`claim-qwen-code-sf-what-it-is`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-identity`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-identity-readme`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-desktop`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-serve`)
- What it is not: not current Gemini CLI; independent since v0.1 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-not-gemini-cli`). Qwen OAuth is no longer a selectable first-run auth path (`claim-qwen-code-sf-auth-oauth-discontinued`)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `runtime` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-primary-type`)
- Secondary roles: `control-plane` for `qwen serve` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-secondary-role-control-plane`); `ide` for the VS Code Companion (`claim-qwen-code-sf-secondary-role-ide`)
- Agent-loop owner: `packages/core` owns model requests, context, tools, and permissions (`claim-qwen-code-sf-agent-loop-owner`)
- Architecture: monorepo with direct CLI execution or ACP execution; `qwen serve` is an optional HTTP+SSE control plane around ACP (`claim-qwen-code-sf-architecture`)

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- Surface IDs: `surface-qwen-code-cli`, `surface-qwen-code-headless`, `surface-qwen-code-vscode`, `surface-qwen-code-zed`, `surface-qwen-code-jetbrains`, `surface-qwen-code-desktop`, `surface-qwen-code-serve`, `surface-qwen-code-web-shell`, `surface-qwen-code-sdk-typescript`, `surface-qwen-code-sdk-python`, `surface-qwen-code-sdk-java`, `surface-qwen-code-acp`, `surface-qwen-code-telegram`, `surface-qwen-code-wechat`, `surface-qwen-code-dingtalk`, `surface-qwen-code-feishu`, `surface-qwen-code-qqbot`, `surface-qwen-code-wecom`, `surface-qwen-code-github-channel`, `surface-qwen-code-gitlab-channel`, `surface-qwen-code-github-actions`
- Execution location: same-device by default for TUI and headless (`claim-qwen-code-sf-execution-local`). `qwen serve` is a local daemon (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-serve`). GitHub Action runs on GitHub-hosted workflows (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-github-actions`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: first-run `/auth` offers Alibaba ModelStudio, third-party providers, or a custom provider (`claim-qwen-code-sf-model-strategy`). `/model` switches `modelProviders` at runtime (`claim-qwen-code-sf-model-strategy-switch`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-model-switching`)
- Auth strategy: provider API keys and env vars; no Qwen Code account login (`claim-qwen-code-sf-auth-strategy`). Qwen OAuth free tier ended 2026-04-15 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-auth-oauth-discontinued`)
- Provider support: openai-compatible, anthropic, gemini, vertex-ai, plus hard-coded qwen-oauth (`claim-qwen-code-sf-provider-support`). README also names Ollama / vLLM local models (`claim-qwen-code-sf-provider-support-readme`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-local-models`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-direct-provider`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-byok`)

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body:
- Context behavior: each session starts with a fresh window; QWEN.md and auto-memory carry knowledge across sessions (`claim-qwen-code-sf-context-behavior`)
- Memory: QWEN.md plus default-on auto-memory; optional git-shared team memory is off by default (`claim-qwen-code-sf-memory`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-persistent-memory`)
- Compaction: hooks fire `PreCompact` for manual or auto compaction (`claim-qwen-code-sf-compaction`). Automatic threshold policy is unknown
- Session behavior: headless `--continue` / `--resume` restore project-scoped chats (`claim-qwen-code-sf-session-headless`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-resumable`). `qwen serve` shares one ACP session per workspace under default `sessionScope: single` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-session-serve`)

sections.heading: Tools, extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, and APIs
sections.body:
- Tools: files, shell, monitor, web_fetch, todo_write, agent, exit_plan_mode, plus MCP (`claim-qwen-code-sf-tools`)
- Extensions: MCP, extensions/skills, channel plugins, SDK clients, and UI adapters (`claim-qwen-code-sf-extensions`)
- MCP: first-party MCP client via `mcpServers` / `qwen mcp` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-mcp`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-mcp`)
- Skills: Agent Skills as `SKILL.md` folders (`claim-qwen-code-sf-skills`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-skills`)
- Hooks: command, http, function, and prompt executors (`claim-qwen-code-sf-hooks`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-hooks`)
- APIs: `qwen serve` HTTP+SSE (`claim-qwen-code-sf-api-serve`); `qwen --acp` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-acp`); TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-sdk-typescript`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-sdk-python`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-sdk-java`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-sdk`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-rpc`)

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body:
- Orchestration: named and fork subagents (`claim-qwen-code-sf-orchestration-subagents`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-subagents`). Experimental Agent Team via `/coordinate` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-orchestration-teams`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-agent-teams`)
- Parallelism: parallel fork subagents sharing a prompt-cache prefix (`claim-qwen-code-sf-parallelism-forks`). Numeric cap unknown on the cited page

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: optional Seatbelt or Docker/Podman sandbox (`claim-qwen-code-sf-isolation-sandbox`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-sandbox`). Optional git worktrees (`claim-qwen-code-sf-worktrees`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-worktrees`)
- Permissions: plan, default/ask, auto-edit, auto, yolo (`claim-qwen-code-sf-permissions`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-permissions`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-human-gates`)
- Security: YOLO auto-approves tools and does not enable a sandbox (`claim-qwen-code-sf-security-yolo-headless`)
- Data path: keys stay in env; model requests go to the configured provider (`claim-qwen-code-sf-data-path`)

sections.heading: Interface inventory plus remote/mobile/background behavior
sections.body:
List each surface from `surfaces.jsonl` separately. Keep native mobile, first-party mobile web, first-party messaging, vendor relay, remote client, private-network, Termux/mobile terminal, and generic remote shell routes distinct.

- Interface and surface IDs:
  - Interactive CLI: `surface-qwen-code-cli` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-cli`)
  - Headless CLI: `surface-qwen-code-headless` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-headless`)
  - VS Code Companion: `surface-qwen-code-vscode` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-vscode`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-compatibility-vscode`)

  - `qwen serve` daemon: `surface-qwen-code-serve` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-serve`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-api-serve`)
  - Web Shell: `surface-qwen-code-web-shell` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-web-shell`)
  - TypeScript SDK: `surface-qwen-code-sdk-typescript` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-sdk-typescript`)
  - Python SDK: `surface-qwen-code-sdk-python` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-sdk-python`)
  - Java SDK: `surface-qwen-code-sdk-java` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-sdk-java`)
  - ACP server: `surface-qwen-code-acp` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-acp`)
  - Telegram: `surface-qwen-code-telegram` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-telegram`)
  - WeChat: `surface-qwen-code-wechat` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-wechat`)
  - DingTalk: `surface-qwen-code-dingtalk` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-dingtalk`)
  - Feishu: `surface-qwen-code-feishu` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-feishu`)
  - QQ Bot: `surface-qwen-code-qqbot` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-qqbot`)
  - WeCom: `surface-qwen-code-wecom` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-wecom`)
  - GitHub notification channel: `surface-qwen-code-github-channel` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-github-channel`)
  - GitLab todo channel: `surface-qwen-code-gitlab-channel` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-gitlab-channel`)
  - GitHub Action: `surface-qwen-code-github-actions` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-surface-github-actions`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-issue-to-pr`)
- Remote behavior: `qwen serve` can bind off loopback with a token and optional TLS for LAN browsers (`claim-qwen-code-sf-remote-access-serve`). Not a first-party vendor relay
- Mobile behavior: phone or tablet can open the LAN Web Shell over HTTPS (`claim-qwen-code-sf-mobile-access`). Messaging channels also accept phone chat clients (`claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-messaging-channel`). No native iOS/Android app was established
- Background behavior: session-scoped `/loop` (`claim-qwen-code-sf-background-scheduled`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-background`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-scheduled`). Persistent channel loops (`claim-qwen-code-sf-background-channels`)

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- Pricing: Coding Plan is a subscription, Token Plan is usage-based, otherwise BYO provider key. Dollar amounts are not on the cited auth page (`claim-qwen-code-sf-pricing`)
- License: Apache-2.0 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-license`)
- Maintenance: active first-party repo push on 2026-08-15 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-maintenance`)
- Lock-in related facts: multi-protocol BYOK and local models (`claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-byok`, `claim-qwen-code-sf-tag-local-models`). Coding Plan uses a dedicated DashScope endpoint (`claim-qwen-code-sf-auth-strategy`)

sections.heading: Lineage and compatibility edges
sections.body:
- Lineage claims: originally based on Gemini CLI v0.8.2; independent since v0.1 (`claim-qwen-code-sf-lineage`). GitHub REST reports `fork` false (`claim-qwen-code-sf-github-fork-flag`)

- Compatibility: VS Code 1.96.0+ (`claim-qwen-code-sf-compatibility-vscode`); ACP JetBrains IDEs plus local CLI (`claim-qwen-code-sf-compatibility-jetbrains`); Zed plus local CLI (`claim-qwen-code-sf-compatibility-zed`)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: independently developed Gemini CLI lineage; open-source multi-protocol CLI (`claim-qwen-code-sf-unique-value`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: `qwen serve` is experimental and local/text-only in v0.16-alpha (`claim-qwen-code-sf-drawback-serve-alpha`); free Qwen OAuth path removed (`claim-qwen-code-sf-drawback-oauth`); YOLO does not sandbox (`claim-qwen-code-sf-security-yolo-headless`)
- Best fit: documented audience is terminal-first developers (`claim-qwen-code-sf-intended-user`). This is not a recommendation
- Not-for: unknown as a product-exclusion list. Identity boundary: not current Gemini CLI (`claim-qwen-code-sf-not-gemini-cli`)
